# Sample Test Questions for Primo_List_2 Email Dataset
# Lines starting with # are ignored
# One question per line

# Temporal queries (testing the fix)
Review recent discussions about Chicago bibliography
What happened with Primo VE last month?
What were the important issues related to the NDE view disscussed on October?

# Factual queries
How do I configure facets in Primo?
What is the Research Assistant feature?
How does NDE display configuration work?

# Topic-based queries
What are the pressing issues with Primo?
Issues with loading or performance
Problems with citation formats

# Specific technical queries

What is the process for GitHub CSL updates?
